chunks: And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:

There is no fasting servant who is insulted and then says, 'Indeed, I am fasting. Peace be upon you. I will not insult you as you insult me,' except that the Lord, Blessed and Exalted, says: 'My servant has sought refuge through fasting from the evil of My servant; I have granted him protection from the Fire.'

key_terms.بِالصَّوْمِ: through fasting; by means of the fast
key_terms.سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ: a peaceful response meaning peace be upon you

ai.seo_question: How should a fasting person respond when insulted?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the fasting person to respond to insult with restraint, peace, and dignity. It presents fasting as a shield that protects a believer from sinful retaliation and becomes a means for protection from the Fire.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1860 - The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

"If a fasting servant is insulted and responds by saying, 'I am fasting; peace be upon you. I will not insult you as you have insulted me,' the Lord (azj), Blessed and Exalted, says: 'My servant has sought refuge through fasting from the evil of My servant; I have granted him protection from the Fire.'"
